findings.evidence: Result::Err maps to Vec::new, unlike the typed keyed API. The legacy caller cannot distinguish an invalid clock from a valid no-violation result.

findings.evidence: External journal callbacks run under the run-table guard; table acquisition expects no poisoning. A panicking callback can break that assumption. The actor-panic control does not exercise journal panic under this guard.
findings.why_deferred: Recovering the mutex does not establish whether an external write committed. Requires fallible lifecycle and durable-recovery qualification rather than silently clearing poison.

ownership_migrations.decision: UX surface emission and catalogue share one exhaustive declaration; graph-specific SurfaceId remains an adapter vocabulary.

ownership_migrations.decision: Descriptor supplies initial defaults. Existing config survives registration/replacement. Downstream ingress/history still enforce their own bounds. Current Mere has no production gate caller or global sender installation. This does not install sampling into nonblocking ingress.
Registry staging rejects newest on overflow; Apparatus retained history evicts oldest and supplies independent readers. Display truncation is neither ingress loss nor retention loss.

ownership_migrations.state: one bounded worker adapter added; whole-app wiring remains open
ownership_migrations.decision: Distillery owns admitted work, worker replies and journal acceptance. Apparatus stores optional fixed redacted observations keyed by generated execution id. Registry correlation and Apparatus envelopes are not made a universal event enum.
Legacy project_skeleton and real batch inspection coexist; settings/inspection consumers have not all migrated. A skeleton is not proof of functioning diagnostics.
Scenario key/input-text call the runner directly while native input has host intercept/default routing. The wheel repair does not declare keyboard/native parity.
